data.title: Bitcoin And Ethereum Get A Bigger Role In US Derivatives Markets: Here’s What The CFTC Changed
data.description: Regulated crypto exchanges and derivatives platforms are getting an easier path to using digital assets in their operations, as the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) is allowing them to count Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and payment stablecoins toward reserves needed to cover a year of o…
